src: identical interior sprite instances inside the shared-border framed panels
path: constant diagonal motion from panel to panel, continued one more standalone panel to the right; vertical offset is scaled from shared-border spacing to full panel width and rounded to the nearest row
trajectory: stamp one copy of the sprite in the next framed panel at the extrapolated row and the same local columns
transform: discard the previous panels; draw only the new single frame with the same frame and fill colors
grid_shape: same height, width of one standalone panel
